title: List Of Names Of Overseas Kuomintang Delegates Who Will Attend The 5Th National Conference At Nanking

page_data.en:
S. B. REGI
D 6/64
1/10/34

October 5 34.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your
letter No. 3042 dated September 27 and to forward
herewith a list of names of overseas Kuomintang
delegates who will attend the 5th National Congress
at Nanking in the near future. This list has
been obtained confidentially from Kuomintang
Authorities in Nanking.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch.

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
S. B. REGI
D 6/64
1934年10月1日

1934年10月5日。

先生：

谨此提及阁下9月27日第3042号来函，并随函附上即将赴南京出席国民党第五次全国代表大会的海外代表名单。该名单系从南京国民党当局秘密获取。

此致
敬礼

警务处特务科主管

J. Van den Berg 先生，
荷兰驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

page_data.en:
CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3042.                                SHANGHAI.      27 September 1934.

Sir,
        I have the honour to inform you that according to a
report in the Sin Wen Pao of 20 September 1934, eleven
delegates of the Kuo Min Tang in Indo China, Chili, Panama,
The Netherlands' Indies, Cuba, Siam and other countries
arrived in Nanking on the 19th instant for the purpose of
attending the forthcoming 5th Congress of this Party.
        I should be much obliged if you could let me know the
names of these delegates from each of these countries.
                                        I have the honour to be,
                                                Sir,
                                Your obedient servant,

                                Chinese Secretary.

T. Robertson, Esquire,
    Shanghai Municipal Police,
        Special Branch,
            SHANGHAI.

Supt. Ian.
?
yP
Office of S.B.
The information desired has been
obtained from Nanking who
desire that it be kept
confidential. Ian 4/10
page_data.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话挂号：HOLLANDIA

第3042号。                                上海。      1934年9月27日。

先生：
        谨此奉告，据1934年9月20日《新闻报》报道，来自印度支那、智利、巴拿马、荷属东印度、古巴、暹罗及其他国家的十一名国民党代表已于本月19日抵达南京，旨在出席即将召开的该党第五次全国代表大会。
        如蒙告知上述各国代表的姓名，不胜感激。
                                        此致
                                                敬礼
                                您的恭顺仆人

                                中文秘书

T. Robertson 先生，
    上海公共租界工部局警务处，
        特务科，
            上海。

Ian 警司。
？

特务科办公室
所需情报已从南京方面获得，
对方要求对此保密。 Ian 10月4日
